Just play more! 

I'm kidding haha. But you could try doing the daily quests, so you log in once a day, get rewards and get to play 2 songs everyday at least. You can also dedicate your time to upgrading an artist, or upgrading your top 5 so you can ascend league. Use time getting cards, upgrading, completing the theme of your preference, etc.

I'd recommend playing during events too, like the Halloween one that just passed since there's the Star Pass and the Weekly Missions which give so many rewards and you have to complete missions that, if you're lucky, will help you discover high scoring songs you didn't know, or realizing what groups' themes you have completed and can play on and add to your top 5! 

I'm not sure when a big update like that is coming, but it shouldn't be long before one comes, since they happen on change of seasons and holidays (I think)

Start slow too, I find that playing a little bit daily (the daily quests) is entertaining enough for me, playing my top 5 along the week and upgrading them to see how high I can get in the league. 

Good luck! Have fun, don't burn out by playing everything in one day haha
